- **History wording correct**: slide 4 reads "Women have been shaping computing since the 1800s" (`banner-1440-4.png`, `banner-390-4.png`). No "200 years" anywhere. The institutional source is bound in `scope.md:7` (Science Museum Group, Ada Lovelace 1843).
- **Radio opens another tab**: `index.html:1170` has `target="_blank" rel="noopener"`, the CTA carries the ↗ affordance, and the copy promises only "put it on in another tab and listen while you browse" — no autoplay or cross-page-player claim.
- **Uniform height, no clipping**: the new CSS (`source-diff.patch:9`) stacks all slides at `grid-area:1/1` with `[hidden]{display:grid;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none}`, so stage height is the tallest slide at all times. All eight 1440 crops render identically slim (two text lines max); all eight 390 crops render the same box with the CTA fully visible. No rotation-induced jump, no truncation.
- **Still slim below the masthead**: `after-viewport-1440.png` is unchanged in height from before; `after-viewport-390.png` grows roughly 45px versus before, still a single compact strip above "What brought you to town today?".
- **Nothing else moved**: six needs shortcuts intact (`index.html:1207-1212`), four categories and 26 direct links inside the collapsed disclosure (`index.html:1218-1235`), masthead buttons and KSVL pill unchanged. The diff touches only the banner block and two banner CSS lines.
- **No misleading route or benefit claim**: every one of the eight destinations is an already-established destination named on this same page — `/fun-connect.html` ("All games and tools"), `#reference` (inline Miss Jeeves), `/radio.html`, `/luminairy.html` (MAiVENS/TRAiLBLAZERS, matching `index.html:1277`), `/library.html`, `/newsstand.html`, `/games/fairy-godmother.html` ("career advice and learn to ask your own AI"), `/mall.html`. No slide claims all games teach AI. Names follow canon (Miss Jeeves, FAiRY Godmother, LIBRAiRY, NewsStand, Big Picture); no retired term appears.
- Hidden slides use `visibility:hidden`, so they stay out of the tab order and the accessibility tree; `Feature 1 of 8` status text and prev/pause/next are correct against the rotator in `homepage.js:587-673`, which pauses on reduced-motion, hover, focus and tab-hidden.

### Non-blocking notes (owner taste / advisory, no change requested)
1. On mobile the image floats and long lines wrap back to the far-left margin under it, so a trailing fragment ("teller.", "that inspire LAiDIES.") sits outside the text column on 4 of 8 slides. Legible and consistent; purely a look call for you.
2. Because hidden slides are now laid out rather than `display:none`, all eight banner images are in-viewport at page entry, so `loading="lazy"` no longer defers seven of them. I could not measure the added byte weight in this read-only pass.

- No shell in this session: I verified the delta text against the working `index.html` line by line, but could not independently recompute the three SHA256 values — they are reported as manifest-stated.

I therefore did not confirm that `/fun-connect.html` inventories a paper fortune teller specifically; Dream Phone and Girl Talk are both confirmed games in the directory.
